The Psychiatric Services SRO provides regional, community-based and patient-oriented psychiatric care for 80,000 residents. We have modern, integrated care structures such as emergency triage, station-equivalent mobile acute care, integrative psychiatric care, social psychiatric and psychotherapeutic outpatients at 4 locations with special offers, as well as rehabilitation day clinic, acute day clinic, old-age psychiatry with ambulatory and day clinic and an inpatient offer with 34 beds in the Langenthal hospital. We have SIWF recognition as a category A institution for 3 years, both outpatient and inpatient. To complement our team, we are looking for the Secretariat in the Ambulatorium in Langenthal on 1st January. October 2026 or by arrangement one or more The varied area of responsibility includes general secretarial and administrative activities as well as organizational matters in the secretariat. This includes, among other things, the organization and coordination of consultation hours, the collection and maintenance of patient data as well as the maintenance of statistics to ensure data deliveries. They appreciate the personal and telephone contact with patients, doctors, psychologists, psychiatric specialists, insurance companies and internal and external services. descriptionByLocale.it:
La nostra clinica del dolore cura pazienti ambulatoriali con sindromi croniche del dolore. Lavorano in un team interdisciplinare composto da psicologia, anestesesiologia, cura e altre aree specializzate. Stiamo cercando uno psicoterapeuta dedicato per la nostra clinica del dolore presso il sito Langenthal. Se c'è la volontà di farlo, c'è la possibilità di assumere la gestione del team di psicologia del dolore.

Questo è ciò che fate con noi
• Gestione professionale e organizzativa del settore della psicologia del dolore
• Attuazione di terapie individuali e di gruppo
• Concentrarsi sulle procedure terapeutiche behavioral

Essi li sostengono nel loro sviluppo professionale e personale, promuovere le loro competenze in modo mirato e contribuire a modellare un ambiente che promuove l'apprendimento. Inoltre, consiglia e accompagna i formatori professionali nel loro ruolo. In situazioni difficili, si mantiene una panoramica, rimanere calmi e agire in modo risolutivo e orientato alla soluzione. For the acute care department, we are looking for a committed, experienced and motivated personality as part of a succession planning immediately or by agreement as you bring about with us In this versatile and responsible function, you accompany learners and students in the acute care department with pleasure and great commitment. They support them in their professional and personal development, promote their competences in a targeted manner and help shape an environment that promotes learning. You also advise and accompany vocational trainers in their role. In challenging situations, you keep an overview, remain calm and act in a conflict-solving and solution-oriented manner. They promote appreciative cooperation and contribute to the sustainable development of educational processes. Together with the second education responsible nursing you form the team Department of Education. Together, you actively shape practical training, implement training-relevant projects and further develop existing concepts.
